name: Titans Trainer
source: Taking place in an alternate universe where Terra is free from her own demise 3 years later, you get to play as Jericho, who was tasked to infiltrate their ranks in the body of Kid Flash. Your mission is to corrupt the Titans and ultimately tear them apart from the inside, without them suspecting anything.
translation: 故事发生在另一个宇宙，三年后，泰拉从自己的灭亡中解脱出来，你将扮演杰里科，他的任务是渗透到闪电小子的体内。你的任务是腐化泰坦并最终将他们从内部撕裂，而不要让他们产生任何怀疑。
